---
title: Handouts and slides
subtitle: 'Printable, editable, and accessible materials'
description: >-
  Every worksheet, chart, template, and slide deck of the course, with its
  web version, its printable PDF, its editable source, and its license.
---

Each handout has these forms:

- an accessible **web page**, which works with a screen reader and on a phone,
- a **PDF** for print in A4, tagged for screen readers (PDF/UA-1),
- a **Word file** for each worksheet that you fill in, so that you can type your answers on a laptop,
- an **editable source**: the Quarto file in the repository folder `contents/handouts/`, and the SVG diagrams or the Markdown file below.

All exercises work on paper, in a Word file on a laptop, or on a flipchart. No exercise needs an online whiteboard or an account.

## Two sheets for the course day

Each participant gets two double-sided A4 sheets. Print them in landscape, double-sided, flipped on the short edge. The Word versions let participants type their answers. Both sheets adapt Liberating Structures Panarchy. They carry CC BY-SA 4.0. Keep this license when you adapt them.

| Handout                                                                                             | Front                                         | Back           | Downloads                                                                                                                           | License      |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| [Sheet 1: Research Use Card and Panarchy Chart](handouts/sheet-1-research-use-panarchy.qmd)         | Instructions and Research Use Card            | Panarchy Chart | [PDF](../assets/handouts/sheet-1-research-use-panarchy.pdf) · [Word](../assets/handouts/sheet-1-research-use-panarchy.docx)         | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| [Sheet 2: Opportunities & Barriers and Action Plan](handouts/sheet-2-opportunities-action-plan.qmd) | Opportunities & Barriers, Block 1 and Block 2 | Action Plan    | [PDF](../assets/handouts/sheet-2-opportunities-action-plan.pdf) · [Word](../assets/handouts/sheet-2-opportunities-action-plan.docx) | CC BY-SA 4.0 |

: Sheets for the course day {.striped}

Groups record their work on a flipchart or in a shared document. No exercise needs sticky notes.

## Slide decks {#slide-decks}

The decks are Reveal.js presentations. Use the arrow keys to move. Press `S` for the presenter notes, `F` for full screen, and `?` for all keyboard shortcuts. The decks contain no dates or venues, so they serve every edition.

| Deck                                                                    | Topic                                                   | License      |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| [Orientation](slides/00-intro.qmd)                                      | The question of the day, four lenses, Research Use Card | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 1: Scale and environment](slides/01-scale.qmd)                    | Footprint and provenance, the BLOOM case                | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 2: Representation and Displacement](slides/02-representation.qmd) | Datasets and stereotypes, the LAION-5B case             | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 3: Lifecycle and labor](slides/03-lifecycle-labor.qmd)            | Hidden labor, the Kenyan labeling case                  | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Lens 4: Political economy](slides/04-political-economy.qmd)            | Power, "open" claims, the EU AI Act                     | CC BY 4.0    |
| [Panarchy](slides/05-panarchy.qmd)                                      | Block 1, Block 2, and the individual Action Plan        | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| [The course day](slides/06-day.qmd)                                     | Running schedule with a countdown, for the room screen  | CC BY-SA 4.0 |

: Slide decks {.striped}

The decks are available as HTML only. PDF versions follow after a check of their legibility and accessibility.

## Case material

- [A random sample from LAION](laion-sample.qmd): entries loaded live from their original sources, with captions and similarity scores, for Lens 2. License: CC BY 4.0 for the page. The rights in the images stay with their creators.
- Build script: `scripts/build_laion_sample.py`. It writes `sample.json` from the raw sample, and the HTML fragments of the page and the slides from `sample.json`. The raw sample and all images stay outside Git.
